newsitem.title: BRAZIL: RESEARCH ALERT-Light still a Salomon hold.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Light still a Salomon hold.

text.p: Salomon Brothers and its local associate Banco Patrimonio reiterated their hold recommendation on shares of Light Servicos de Eletricidade SA, the Rio de Janeiro electric utility.

-- "As the first Brazilian electric utility to be privatized to foreign investors, Light has seen an aggressive operational restructuring since its privatization a year ago," analysts Gilbert Casillas and Victor Moraes wrote in a report.
-- The analysts said Light was in an enviable position among Brazilian utilities, as it will be able to fund its near-term investment program with internal cash flow.

-- "Beyond the next three years, we project the company will have ample additional cash flow," they said, adding that the company may use the extra cash to raise dividends or take part in other privatizations in Brazil.
-- Salomon said it was reiterating its hold rating although the company has improved, and it will continue to do so because the stock's current price "adequately discounts this outlook."
-- Light's common was up 9.99 reais at 539.99 reais in midafternoon trading on Thursday.
